The masterminds spawn-policy change passes review: the owner's ask is met with a one-line rule change in `Servex/agents/policy.js` and a test. On the branch the policy test passes (61 checks).

⚠️ The change only takes effect after Servex restarts. Until then, the voice mastermind's retry at spawning the page and AI masterminds will still be refused.

There was no `requirements.md` in the task folder, so I reviewed against the brief its task log points to, `ask-00dc4855.md`. Two of my notes are worth a look:
- The new summary line in the rules list says a task mastermind spawns "mastermind, minion and helper". That's too narrow: a task mastermind can also spawn most other roles, as a manager can.
- The grant covers only the `mastermind` role. A voice mastermind still can't spawn a `page-mastermind`, `task-mastermind` or `manager`.

The report is at `public/framework/ai/sessions/2026/10/15/voice-20261015/spawn-policy/review.md`.
